author: Mooriie
body: So about 17 Days ago I got banned from Avicus, the reason was because I was using fly hacks, first I want to start of by apologizing tremendously for ruining the game for everyone, and also trying to lie to the mods, ect on the forum by telling them I did not use any hacks. Second of I think what I did was foolish because it makes the game really unfair and unfun for everyone playing, I am sorry that I wasted so much time telling lies and not just admitting it to the staff, I Promise to not just not use hacks but follow rules and be respectful to everyone on the Avicus Community, Sorry.
